I have data of other falls, in Persia and Asiatic Turkey, of edible substances.
But concomitants of this fall: Loud noises were heard in the sky.
Over and over have we noted the occurrence of strange falls in storms.

scripture.text: The very truth--Heart's Lord!--of Sannyas, Abstention; and enunciation, Lord!
I will to thee unfold Some portions of My Majesty, whose powers are manifold!
Yea! for its leaves Are green and waving hymns which whisper Truth!
He said, Yea. 22:28 And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom.
This friendly human frame, my mind can think Calm thoughts once more; my heart beats still again!
